entry.title: dotnet/runtime - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-01-17
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • .NET 10 - System.ExecutionEngineException in System.Reflection.MethodBaseInvoker.InvokeWithOneArg #123318

  • JIT: Redundant bounds check #123312
    11.0.0
  • Base64.DecodeFromUtf8() has incorrect behavior when a final quantum is split by whitespace and isFinalBlock=false #123311
    11.0.0
  • [API Proposal]: DiagnosticMethodInfo should return full method signature #123308
  • [browser] Fix building with satellite assemblies coming from nuget package containing multiple cultures #123305
    11.0.0
  • Running a .NET Framework 4.7.2 Windows Service on Windows 10/11 ARM64 #123303
  • Simpler nullcheck can be emitted #123302
    Future
  • CSE CQ issue #123301
    Future

Closed

  • [API Proposal]: adding C# option to the [StringSyntaxAttribute] #122604
